review: 731.1a-1: decisions had A discard and draw after Brimstone Vandal's trigger resolved, but both happen during Into the Night's resolution, before the trigger goes on the stack; reordered the decisions.
731.2a-1, 731.2b-1: Opt's scry choice was left open; the Opt delta now fixes it (card kept on top, then drawn).

731.2c-1: a_casts_vandal was labelled does_not_fire although the designation does not change there either way (day, one spell cast); relabelled it other and made the day variant, where the check runs and day becomes night, the does_not_fire contrast.

scenarios.title: A permanent entering a game that is neither day nor night makes it day, and only then

setup.notes: The game has neither the day nor the night designation (the game starts with neither).

decisions: A casts Brimstone Vandal, tapping the three Mountains.
Both players pass; Brimstone Vandal resolves and enters the battlefield.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Brimstone Vandal enters the battlefield and the game gains the day designation; the game has exactly one designation, day. The day-or-night change trigger does not fire (it was neither, not night becoming day) and B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: already_night
variants.delta: The game already has the night designation before A casts Brimstone Vandal.
variants.expected: Brimstone Vandal enters the battlefield and the game stays night; it does not become day. The day-or-night change trigger does not fire and B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: already_day
variants.delta: The game already has the day designation before A casts Brimstone Vandal.
variants.expected: Brimstone Vandal enters the battlefield and the game stays day, with exactly one designation. The trigger does not fire and B stays at 20 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge stores the designation as a nullable boolean on the game (null is neither); Brimstone Vandal's replacement effect is gated by DayTime$ Neither.

scenarios.title: Day becomes night: the game loses one designation and gains the other

setup.notes: The game has the day designation.

decisions: A casts Into the Night, tapping the four Mountains.
Both players pass; Into the Night resolves: it becomes night, A discards zero cards, then draws one card.
Brimstone Vandal's day-or-night change trigger, if it fired, goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The game loses the day designation and gains the night designation, so it is night. Brimstone Vandal's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19). A draws one card.

variants.label: already_night
variants.delta: The game already has the night designation before Into the Night resolves.
variants.expected: Into the Night resolves and the game stays night; no designation changes hands. Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20. A draws one card.

variants.label: neither
variants.delta: The game has neither designation before Into the Night resolves.
variants.expected: Into the Night resolves and the game gains the night designation, so it is night. Night did not replace day, so Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20. A draws one card.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the neither variant Brimstone Vandal has to be on the battlefield without its enters-as-day replacement having applied, which needs a puzzle or setup-state placement.

scenarios.title: In the next untap step, day becomes night if the previous turn's active player cast no spells

setup.notes: The game has the day designation. Neither player has cast a spell this turn.

decisions: A passes priority in main2 without casting anything; B passes.
A passes priority in the end step; B passes. The turn ends and B's turn begins.
In B's untap step the game checks the previous turn; if the designation changes, Brimstone Vandal's trigger goes on the stack in B's upkeep and both players pass so it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: In B's untap step, because A cast no spells during A's turn, day becomes night. Brimstone Vandal's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19). The game is night.

variants.label: a_cast_one
variants.delta: In main2, A casts Savannah Lions, tapping Plains, before passing; it resolves.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions is on the battlefield. In B's untap step the game stays day, since A cast a spell during A's turn. Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20.

variants.label: b_cast_one
variants.delta: In A's end step, B casts Opt, tapping Island; it resolves, B scries 1 keeping the card on top, then draws it.
variants.expected: A still cast no spells; B's spell does not count. In B's untap step day becomes night, Brimstone Vandal's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19). The game is night.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Untap phase calls doDayTime with the previous turn's active player and counts only that player's spells cast last turn.

scenarios.title: In the next untap step, night becomes day if the previous turn's active player cast two or more spells

setup.notes: The game has the night designation. Neither player has cast a spell this turn.

decisions: A casts the first Savannah Lions, tapping a Plains; both players pass and it resolves.
A casts the second Savannah Lions, tapping the other Plains; both players pass and it resolves.
A passes priority through the rest of the turn without casting anything else; B passes. The turn ends and B's turn begins.
In B's untap step the game checks the previous turn; if the designation changes, Brimstone Vandal's trigger goes on the stack in B's upkeep and both players pass so it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Both Savannah Lions are on the battlefield. In B's untap step, because A cast two spells during A's turn, night becomes day. Brimstone Vandal's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19). The game is day.

variants.label: a_cast_one
variants.delta: A casts only the first Savannah Lions and does not cast the second.
variants.expected: One Savannah Lions is on the battlefield and the other is still in A's hand. In B's untap step the game stays night, since A cast only one spell. Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20.

variants.label: b_cast_second
variants.delta: The second spell is cast by B instead of A: after the first Savannah Lions resolves, A passes priority and B casts Opt, tapping Island; it resolves, B keeping the scried card on top and drawing it.
variants.expected: One Savannah Lions is on the battlefield; A cast one spell, and B's Opt does not count toward A's total. In B's untap step the game stays night, Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge requires strictly more than one spell cast by the previous turn's active player.

scenarios.title: If the game is neither day nor night, the untap-step check does not happen

setup.notes: The game has neither the day nor the night designation, although the Brimstone Vandal on the battlefield is already in play (placed by the setup, without its enters-as-day replacement having applied). A has cast no spells this turn.

decisions: A passes priority in main2 without casting anything; B passes.
A passes priority in the end step; B passes. The turn ends and B's turn begins.
B's untap step runs the day-and-night check; both players pass priority in B's upkeep.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The game stays neither day nor night, even though A cast no spells. Brimstone Vandal's trigger does not fire and B stays at 20.

variants.label: a_casts_vandal
variants.delta: In main2, A casts the second Brimstone Vandal from hand, tapping the three Mountains; it resolves.
variants.expected: The second Brimstone Vandal enters and, because it was neither, the game becomes day; the first Vandal's trigger does not fire. In B's untap step the game is day and A cast one spell, so it stays day; no trigger fires and B stays at 20.

variants.label: day
variants.delta: The game has the day designation instead of neither.
variants.expected: In B's untap step, because A cast no spells, day becomes night. Brimstone Vandal's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19). The game is night.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's doDayTime does nothing when the game's designation is null. Placing Brimstone Vandal on the battlefield while neither needs a puzzle or setup-state placement.
